# Ummah Collective

> Applied-AI studio in Kuala Lumpur building software, AI agents and growth systems for values-aligned companies. Tagline: "Intelligence, with integrity." Founded 2022, on a Berlin agency lineage since 2014. Working languages: English, German, Malay, Arabic, Chinese, Turkish. Markets: Malaysia and Southeast Asia, Germany and the DACH region, the Gulf.

Ummah Collective Sdn. Bhd. is a boutique studio, not a large agency. It designs and builds digital assets that a company owns: websites and platforms, custom CRM software, AI agents that handle sales and support conversations, workflow automation, and the content and outbound systems that bring demand to them. Islamic ethics and halal-market fluency are the trust layer beneath the work rather than the headline.

## Services
- [AI Agents](https://ummah-collective.com/service-ai-agents.html): agents that answer, qualify and follow up on WhatsApp, email and web chat.
- [Automation and Workflows](https://ummah-collective.com/service-automation.html): removing manual handoffs between tools, quotes, invoices and CRM records.
- [Custom CRM](https://ummah-collective.com/service-custom-crm.html): one source of truth built around how a company actually sells.
- [App and Software Development](https://ummah-collective.com/service-app-development.html): internal tools, portals and products.
- [Web Design and Platforms](https://ummah-collective.com/service-web-design.html): premium multilingual sites engineered for conversion.
- [Branding and Strategy](https://ummah-collective.com/service-branding.html): positioning, identity and messaging.
- [Lead Generation and Performance Marketing](https://ummah-collective.com/service-lead-generation.html): outbound and paid demand.
- [SEO and Content](https://ummah-collective.com/service-seo-content.html): search authority, answer-engine visibility and content engines.
- [Social Media Automation](https://ummah-collective.com/service-social-media-automation.html): consistent publishing without a full-time hire.
- [Shariah Compliance and Halal Audit](https://ummah-collective.com/service-shariah-audit.html): scholar-reviewed compliance for digital products.

## Products
- [Noon OS](https://www.noon-os.com): business command centre and CRM for the halal economy, from EUR 19 per month.
- [DeenGen](https://www.deengen.com): Shariah-compliant crypto and trading education. Education only, never financial advice.
- [Rayhan Kids](https://www.rayhan-kids.com): premium Islamic interactive products for children.
- [niyya](https://niyya.my): halal beverage brand.
- [Ummah Hub](https://ummah-collective.com/ummah-hub): coworking space in Petaling Jaya, Kuala Lumpur, built on Islamic values.

## Verified case study
- [ANAAKA](https://ummah-collective.com/project-anaaka.html): European halal skincare brand taken from no Malaysian presence to a flagship store at TRX over 16 months. Measured results: 10,446 sessions, 8,244 users, 6,432 Instagram followers, and 18.45 percent of revenue from organic search. These are the only client performance figures Ummah Collective publishes.
